summary: Requested preview chart features verified against public API and browser. Backend 18/18 tests pass. Both battery views render cyan power and dashed lime SoC curves with W/% tooltips; separate chart has left W/right % ticks. Daily grouped bars match API values and four channel colors. Two distribution bars and 19 deltas preserved. All five ranges work; original /verlauf charts remain accessible and unchanged in git diff. No main-content horizontal overflow at 1920x800 or 390x844. One minor error-state issue reproduced.

integration_issues.issue: MOCKED HTTP 503 from /api/energy/balance displays 'Noch keine Tageswerte vorhanden.' rather than a load-error state. Real public API works. Priority LOW.

action_items: Distinguish daily chart fetch failures from a successful empty response; optionally offer retry.
critical_code_review_comments: BalanceHistoryBars.jsx catch resets rows to [] and finally clears loading; no error state distinguishes failed fetch from valid empty history.
BalanceHistoryBars fetches only on mount, so daily totals/buckets remain static while the surrounding page polls. Consider refresh polling or a refresh control if live daily bars are intended.

success_rate.frontend: All requested acceptance flows passed; supplemental balance error-state check failed

seed_data_creation: None; no database writes. Hardware remains existing DEMO/MOCKED mode. Only supplemental unavailable-yesterday and balance-503 scenarios used temporary MOCKED browser network interception.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Previous missing-yesterday bug is fixed: aborted day_offset=1 leaves all 19 deltas 'Gestern: –'. No runtime pageerrors seen. Four daily buckets contain 13 nonzero SVG bar paths (3 PV, 3 self, 4 import, 3 export); zero-value bars correctly have no rectangle. Initial test incorrectly expected 16 paths and used empty Recharts YAxis wrappers; corrected tests read svg text and nonzero counts. Separate tooltip verified Akku -263 W / SoC 32%. Original history title uses uppercase rendered text; power and SoC verified by >=5 line paths. Both views and both viewport widths verified; mobile additionally checked actual main DOM bounds, excluding SVG/tooltips. UI regression file updated from executed checks as a reusable replay entry point (await run(page)); saved aggregate entry point not separately executed. No application source changes made.
rca of the issue: BalanceHistoryBars.jsx lines 29-30 swallow network failure, clear rows, and finish loading. Reproduce by fulfilling /api/energy/balance with 503 then reloading /verlauf-preview; vp-balance-history-empty claims no historical values even though public API returns four buckets. Add separate error state rather than overloading an empty array. No real API outage observed.
